name: openpixo/low-poly-3d
title: Low-poly 3D
description: Faceted forms, matte materials and soft light for cohesive stylized 3D asset concepts.

description_i18n.en: Faceted forms, matte materials and soft light for cohesive stylized 3D asset concepts.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用分面形体、哑光材质和柔光，制作统一的风格化 3D 资产概念图。

examples.title: Merchant cart concept
examples.prompt: Generate a low-poly merchant cart concept using the low-poly-3d art style, with a striped canvas canopy, three wooden crates and sturdy wheels. Use a consistent orthographic three-quarter view and matte materials.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 low-poly-3d 美术风格生成低多边形商人推车概念图：条纹帆布棚、三个木箱和结实车轮。采用统一的正交四分之三视角与哑光材质。

examples.title: Forest prop family
examples.prompt: Create matching 3D asset concept views using the low-poly-3d art style for a pine tree, boulder and tree stump. Share facet scale, upper-left lighting and a muted forest palette.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 low-poly-3d 美术风格为松树、巨石和树桩制作配套的 3D 资产概念图。统一分面尺度、左上方光照和低饱和森林配色。

style.prompt: Stylized low-poly 3D game asset concept rendered with visible planar facets, economical geometry and matte untextured materials. Use the shared earthy palette, consistent three-quarter orthographic framing and a large soft key light from the upper left. Let face orientation create broad value changes, preserve simple silhouettes and keep bevels minimal and deliberate.
style.negativePrompt: photorealism, smooth high-poly sculpt, subdivision gloss, tiny surface texture, noisy normal maps, chrome, heavy depth of field, exaggerated perspective, text, logo, watermark

constraints.outline: Faceted silhouette defined by geometry; no ink contour.
